description:
Get heartbeat score for a registration

A registered token's health on one chain: the heartbeat score (0-100) the oracle published for it in the latest daily epoch, the status derived from it, the three parts it is built from (age, DEX volume, holder health) and how many epochs in a row it has been under 60. A registration whose heartbeat stays under 60 for 30 epochs can lapse and become claimable again, so the score tells a live token page from a dormant one. Answers 404 for a symbol that has no registration on that chain, and for a registration past its 30-day grace period that no epoch has scored yet.

`outlook` reads that published leaf forward: the first daily count projected under 60, the day the name can be registered by anyone who proves the same contract, and the least trading (or the fewest more holders) that holds 60. The coin's health notices say the same.

chain.description: Chain key (e.g. `arbitrum`, `base`, `solana`). A Solana registration is answered from its committed leaf alone (`chainId` 0).

tokenAddress.description: The token's contract address, when several tokens on the chain share the ticker.

name: check_heartbeat

atRiskDays.description: Consecutive epochs the score has been under 60. At 30 the name can be registered again.

confidence.description: Staleness annotation (0-100). 100 when underlying market data is < 1h old, 0 when ≥ 12h, linear in between. NOT part of the on-chain leaf hash.

holders.description: Holder Health Score (0-100, weight 20%) — composite of concentration, suspicious-wallet ratio, distribution, and scale

volume.description: Volume score (0-100, weight 30%) — DEX volume blended across 24h + 7d (default 70/30) and capped at 100× pool liquidity, then log-scaled into [$20, $100k]

epoch.description: The daily epoch whose leaf this is. Absent for a new registration no epoch has scored yet.

lastUpdated.description: When the epoch was scored (its start, 00:00 UTC). For a new registration no epoch has scored yet, when it was registered.

outlook.description:
The latest committed leaf read forward; null while the registration has no leaf. Dates are
daily counts (00:00 UTC, 4 PM PT in winter): a leaf is scored at its epoch's start.

atRiskDays.description: Consecutive daily counts under 60 (30 make the name reclaimable).

age.description: The age part (0-100, weight 50%); steps down at 30, 90, 180, 365 and 730 days.

projectedInactiveAt.description: The first daily count projected under 60 if trading and holders stay as they are (an age step, or the end of the grace period); null when none is, or the score already is.

reclaimableFrom.description: When anyone who proves the same contract can register the name if the score stays under 60 through the countdown (the day after its 30th count); counted from the projected crossing for a coin not yet under 60. Null when neither applies.

status.description: `healthy` 80+, `moderate` 65-79, `at_risk` 60-64, `inactive` under 60 (the 30-day countdown runs), `grace` while the leaf carries the 30-day grace score.

takes.description: What keeps the score at 60 or over, while the countdown runs or one is projected (against the parts projected for the crossing). Both null when 60 is not in question.

dailyVolumeUSD.description: The least trading, in whole US dollars a day, that does it from the next count; null when trading alone cannot (out of reach, or capped by the pool's liquidity at 100 times it).

moreHolders.description: The fewest more holders that do it by count alone, everything else as it is; null when they cannot within 1,000.

score.description: Composite heartbeat score (0-100), the weighted sum of timestamp + volume + holder-health rounded to a whole number, as published in the epoch's leaf.

status.description: Heartbeat status derived from the score: `grace_period`, `healthy`, `moderate`, `at_risk` or `inactive`

title: Check a token's heartbeat
